description: OFFICIAL rates a named institution published — 'what is the ECB rate for USD?', 'Bank of Japan rate today', 'HMRC rate for invoicing'. These are the fixed, citable rates for compliance, tax, customs and accounting — NOT live market rates (use get_exchange_rate for those). Omit `date` for the newest published table (no API key needed); give `date` (API key, paid plan) for the table in force that day — weekends/holidays roll back to the last published date and the response's `rate_date` says which. Omit source/target for the full table; give both for one pair — cross-computed inside the bank's own table when not directly published, flagged `derived`. Always cite the returned `rate_date`.

bank.description: Source code from list_central_banks, e.g. 'ecb', 'fed', 'boe', 'rbi', 'hmrc'. Case-insensitive.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest table.

source.description: Optional. With target, narrows to one pair.

target.description: Optional. With source, narrows to one pair.

name: get_official_rates

derived.description: True when cross-computed inside the bank table

rate_date.description: Publication date of the table — cite this, not today

stale.description: True when the institution is behind its publication schedule

title: Get a bank's official published rates
